title: Reading Drill — Studying wait times at a clinic — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Studying wait times at a clinic — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The clinic administrator in Millcross received an old report about patients seeing late arrivals called first. The report compared time from check-in to being called, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the anonymous arrival records rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered five weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include urgent cases. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a display explaining the appointment order as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
